:::{#exm-inference-rules}
#### Chaining rules of inference
<!-- no-figure: the derivation is the display -->

Suppose these three [premises](#def-premise) are true:

- "if it rains, then the game is cancelled";
- "if the game is cancelled, then we go to the museum";
- "we do not go to the museum".

By [modus tollens](#thm-modus-tollens) on the second and third premises,
"the game is not cancelled" is true.
By modus tollens again,
on the first [premise](#def-premise) and the fact derived from them,
"it does not rain" is true.
So the [conclusion](#def-conclusion) "it does not rain" follows from the premises.

:::
